description: Tube-and-fitting scaffold: standards (verticals) on base plates, ledgers along X and transoms along Z at every lift, zig-zag face braces on the front (+Z), board decks on the lifts and guard rails at the top. Runs along +X from x = 0. Pivot at the start, on the ground, centred in depth. Pieces: scaffold_tubes (galvanized), scaffold_boards (wood_light), scaffold_plates (metal_dark). Every piece is closed.

depth.desc: distance between the front and back standards (m)

braces.desc: diagonal braces on the front face

tubes_lines.note: every tube as a two-point polyline

params.code: for (let i = 0; i <= Math.round(bays); i++) for (const z of [-depth / 2, depth / 2]) { const q = addpoint(0, [i * bay_width, 0.01, z]); setpointattrib(0, 'scale', q, [0.15, 0.02, 0.15]); }

const m = JSON.parse(detail(0, 'materials') || '{}')[s@material]; if (!m) return; const k = haspointattrib(0, 'tint') ? point(0, 'tint', primpoints(0, @primnum)[0]) || 1 : 1; @Cd = mul(m.baseColor, k);
